# costfluent_team_member (Resource)

Manages one member of the organization in one team, with the role they hold there. The costfluent_user data source looks a member's ID up by email. Needs an organization token with `manageTeam` and `viewMembers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costfluent_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

data "costfluent_user" "lena" {
  email = "lena@example.com"
}

# Lena edits in every workspace the platform team can edit
resource "costfluent_team_member" "lena_platform" {
  team_id = costfluent_team.platform.id
  user_id = data.costfluent_user.lena.id
  role    = "editor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) The member's role in the team: viewer or editor, never above their organization role (a Viewer can only be a team viewer).
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `user_id` (String) ID of a member of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "<team ID>:<user ID>".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# "<team ID>:<user ID>"
terraform import costfluent_team_member.lena_platform team_0000000000000000000001:usr_0000000000000000000001
```
